# How to contribute

## Prerequisites

- [Reagordi goal and values](https://reagordi.com/docs/internals/001-values)
- [Namespaces](https://reagordi.com/docs/internals/004-namespaces)
- [Git commit messages](https://reagordi.com/docs/internals/006-git-commit-messages)
- [Exceptions](https://reagordi.com/docs/internals/007-exceptions)
- [Interfaces](https://reagordi.com/docs/internals/008-interfaces)

## Getting started

Since Reagordi consists of many packages, we have a [special development tool](https://reagordi.com/docs/internals/005-development-tool).

1. [Clone the repository](https://github.com/reagordi/dev-tool).

2. [Set up your own fork](https://github.com/reagordi/dev-tool#using-your-own-fork).

3. Now you are ready. Fork any package listed in `packages.php` and do `./reagordi-dev install username/package`.

If you don't have any particular package in mind to start with:

- [Check roadmap](https://reagordi.com/docs/internals/003-roadmap).
- Check package issues at github. Usually there are some.

## Reporting a Security Issue

If you have encountered a security-related issue with Reagordi, please use the [security issue form](https://reagordi.com/security) to report any security issues you have encountered to us.

***WARNING!*** DO NOT use the issue tracker or discuss it in the public forum as it will cause more damage than help.
